items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: He can read anything I put in front of him, flawlessly, and he’s learning Charlie Parker solos perfectly.

ctx.x: Yeah. Boy that’s a learning experience.

Um hum. And well anyway now I have two other kids. One is learning very quickly. He can read anything. He’s about maybe 12 I guess. He can read anything I put in front of him, flawlessly, and he’s learning Charlie Parker solos perfectly. And then a second kid who is doing something very similar and they’re both showing a lot of talent. But I can work with their improv, if I make a comment about chords. Like the first one, he understands a II-V-I progression and he understands when he’s not on that, and he hears…
And when Mom and Dad come to you and say what do you think about my son or daughter making a career in music, do you have a — what do you tell them?
